uncovered_shapes.sentence: Earlier this month, chief election officer Gib van Ert wrote the Municipal Affairs Ministry asking the government to decree the seventh-place finisher elected instead of holding a byelection, according to the Surrey Now-Leader.

claims.claim: Premier-designate Lorne Doerkson said the incoming B.C. Conservative government will not hold a fall legislative session, with cabinet sworn in Friday and the substantive agenda beginning in the spring.
claims.episode_span: Premier-designate Lorne Doerkson told CBC News the incoming government will not hold a fall legislative session.
claims.source_title: Incoming B.C. Conservative government will not hold fall legislative session
claims.supporting_quote: Premier-designate Lorne Doerkson's cabinet is set to be sworn in on Friday, but he told CBC News the incoming government's "substantive legislative agenda" would begin to be heard in the spring session.

claims.claim: Unifor Local 333 transit workers in Greater Victoria are escalating job action, and about 790 workers have been without a contract for over a year.
claims.episode_span: Around 790 transit workers have been without a contract for over a year.
claims.source_title: Greater Victoria commuters could be impacted by rolling transit strikes
claims.supporting_quote: B.C. Transit said in a Monday statement that workers represented by Unifor Local 333 were escalating job action. Around 790 transit workers have been without a contract for over a year.

claims.claim: A tribunal ordered WestJet to pay a B.C. couple more than $2,000 after finding a cancellation was within the airline's control, and awarded the passengers $1,000 each.
claims.episode_span: The tribunal found the issue was within the airline's control and awarded the passengers $1,000 each.
claims.source_title: WestJet ordered to pay B.C. couple more than $2,000 — including part of alcohol tab — after delay
claims.supporting_quote: WestJet fought the claim, saying the cancellation was the result of maintenance required for safety purposes, but the tribunal found the issue was within the airline's control, and awarded the passengers $1,000 each.

claims.claim: B.C. added 12,300 jobs in October, with gains concentrated in part-time and self-employment, while the housing market continues to struggle.
claims.episode_span: B.C. added 12,300 jobs in October, Bryan Yu reports.
claims.source_title: Bryan Yu: B.C. employment rebounds in October while housing market continues to struggle
claims.supporting_quote: B.C. added 12,300 jobs in October, though gains were concentrated in part-time and self-employment

claims.claim: Telus is backing out of planned data centre projects in downtown Vancouver and Mount Pleasant, and Westbank says it will find a new partner.

claims.claim: A Surrey school board byelection would cost about $840,000, funded entirely by the school district, and any court application must be filed by Friday.

claims.source_title: Surrey divided on byelection possibility for vacant school board slot

claims.claim: Garry Thind is disqualified from his Surrey school trustee seat once sworn in as an MLA on Thursday.
claims.episode_span: Garry Thind's Surrey school board seat becomes vacant when he is sworn in as an MLA on Thursday
claims.source_title: Surrey divided on byelection possibility for vacant school board slot
claims.supporting_quote: Thind’s provincial win automatically disqualifies him from holding the school board seat once he is sworn in as an MLA on Thursday.

claims.claim: The Canucks beat the Utah Mammoth 3-2, with Brock Boeser recording three points and Nikita Tolopilo stopping 32 of 34 shots.
claims.episode_span: The Canucks beat the Utah Mammoth 3-2 on Monday for their first back-to-back wins of the season
claims.source_title: Canucks ‘More Connected’ as they Put Mammoth on Ice in 3-2 Win
claims.supporting_quote: Tolopilo stood tall between the pipes, helping the Canucks close out a tight contest by stopping 32 of 34 shots he faced.

claims.claim: Highway 99 northbound in Delta has a left lane blocked at the Highway 17A merge after a vehicle incident.

claims.source_title: DriveBC: 7 major road events in Metro Vancouver
claims.supporting_quote: Vehicle incident at Highway 99, In Delta and At Highway 17A on-ramp / merge. Left lane blocked.
